text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Disy party vice-president says it is practically impossible for a party conference to convene before May.
- American basketball player for AEL of Limassol is suspected of taking performance-enhancing drugs.
- Security Council expresses concern over tension in Cyprus.
- Armaments in Cyprus worry U.N. Security Council.
- Cyprus Ports Authority is to investigate bribes allegations.
- Cypriot delegates work for changes to the Council of Europe's draft resolution on Cyprus.
- Parliament has the right to amend the constitution to avoid a by-election, says the atttorney general.
- Shopkeepers union complain of slow business.
- The Central Bank is due to take a decision soon to lower interest rates.
- Council of Ministers is due to examine findings of a special commission looking at alleged irregularities in tender procedures in electricity authority.
- Refugee organisations will submit group applications against Turkey for violating their ownership rights by occupying their land.
